description_en: Conducts a streaming conversation with JVS Crew using the Server-Sent Events (SSE) protocol to push conversation content in real time
description_zh: 与 JVS Crew 进行流式对话，采用 Server-Sent Events (SSE) 协议实时推送对话内容
kebab_example: aliyun wuyingai chat --input '[{"Role":"user","Content":[{"FileUrl":"/workspace/report.pdf","Type":"text","FileName":"report.pdf","ImageUrl":"https://example.com/img.jpg","Text":"帮我分析这张图片"}]}]' --session-id test-session-001 --routing-key example-string --authorization Bearer%20eyJhb0000...0000k --external-user-id test-user --template-id template-abc123 --stream-options IncludeReasoning=false IncludeToolCalls=false --settings OutputFileMode=url --model example-string --resume true --region cn-hangzhou
name: Chat

fields.help_en: The image URL or base64-encoded string (Type=image)
fields.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The message list (JSON string), sorted in chronological order
parameters.help_zh: 消息列表（JSON 字符串），按时间顺序排列
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The session ID, used for multi-turn conversation context persistence
parameters.help_zh: 会话 ID，用于多轮对话上下文保持
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The routing key, used to specify the backend instance that processes the request
parameters.help_zh: 路由键，用于指定处理请求的后端实例
parameters.name: routing_key

parameters.help_en: Bearer + the JWT returned by GetAccessToken. The entire string is URL-encoded and placed in the query string
parameters.help_zh: Bearer + 由 GetAccessToken 返回的 JWT，整段 URL 编码后放入 Query
parameters.name: authorization

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to include the model thinking process. If set to false, the SSE stream does not include messages with Type="reasoning" or their content events
fields.help_zh: 是否包含模型思考过程。设为 false 时，SSE 流中将不包含 Type="reasoning" 的 message 和其 content 事件
fields.name: include_reasoning

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to include tool invocation details. If set to false, the SSE stream does not include messages of type plugin_call/plugin_call_output/mcp_call/mcp_call_output or their content events
fields.help_zh: 是否包含工具调用详情。设为 false 时，SSE 流中将不包含 plugin_call/plugin_call_output/mcp_call/mcp_call_output 类型的 message 和其 content 事件
fields.name: include_tool_calls

parameters.help_en: The streaming output control options. Contains IncludeReasoning (boolean, default true, specifies whether to include the model thinking process) and IncludeToolCalls (boolean, default true, specifies whether to include tool invocation details). If not specified or a null object is passed, the behavior is consistent with the legacy version
parameters.help_zh: 流式输出控制选项。包含 IncludeReasoning（boolean，默认 true，是否包含模型思考过程）和 IncludeToolCalls（boolean，默认 true，是否包含工具调用详细信息）。不传或传空对象时行为与旧版一致
parameters.name: stream_options

fields.help_en: Controls the file output mode. Valid values: url or base64. For backward compatibility, the default is base64 if this parameter is not specified
fields.help_zh: 控制文件输出模式的参数，可选url或base64， 当前为兼容旧版不传本参数默认使用 base64
fields.name: output_file_mode

parameters.help_en: Additional settings. Contains the output file mode control parameter OutputFileMode (string, valid values: url or base64. For backward compatibility, the default is base64. We recommend url)
parameters.help_zh: 其他设置信息。包含输出文件模式控制参数OutputFileMode（string，可选url或base64，当前为兼容旧版默认 base64，推荐使用url）
parameters.name: settings

parameters.help_en: 断线续传标识。设为 true 时表示恢复上一次未完成的流式响应，此时 Input 必须为空
parameters.help_zh: 断线续传标识。设为 true 时表示恢复上一次未完成的流式响应，此时 Input 必须为空
parameters.name: resume

Content.description_en: The content block list (included only when the status is completed)
Content.description_zh: 内容块列表（仅 completed 时携带）

Data.description_en: Structured data (such as tool calling). Example: {"call_id":"call_xxx","name":"get_weather", "output":"Tool output details, in text format"}. This field is returned when the response includes tool calling results
Data.description_zh: 结构化数据（如工具调用）。示例：{"call_id":"call_xxx","name":"get_weather", "output":"工具返回明细，文本格式"}
Data.title_en: 结构化数据（如工具调用）。示例：{"call_id":"call_xxx","name":"get_weather", "output":"工具返回明细，文本格式"}
Data.title_zh: 结构化数据（如工具调用）。示例：{"call_id":"call_xxx","name":"get_weather", "output":"工具返回明细，文本格式"}

Content.title_en: 内容块列表（仅 completed 时携带）
Content.title_zh: 内容块列表（仅 completed 时携带）

Id.description_en: The unique identifier of the message

SequenceNumber.description_en: The event sequence number (an incrementing integer in string form, used to ensure ordering). When StreamOptions filters out certain event types, filtered events still consume sequence numbers, so the sequence numbers received by the client may not be consecutive
SequenceNumber.description_zh: 事件序号（字符串形式的递增整数，用于保证顺序）。注意：当 StreamOptions 过滤掉某类事件时，被过滤事件仍占用序号，因此客户端收到的序号可能不连续
SequenceNumber.title_en: 事件序号（字符串形式的递增整数，用于保证顺序）。注意：当 StreamOptions 过滤掉某类事件时，被过滤事件仍占用序号，因此客户端收到的序号可能不连续
SequenceNumber.title_zh: 事件序号（字符串形式的递增整数，用于保证顺序）。注意：当 StreamOptions 过滤掉某类事件时，被过滤事件仍占用序号，因此客户端收到的序号可能不连续

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

Text.description_en: The incremental text content (included in Object=content events)
Text.description_zh: 增量文本内容（Object=content 事件携带）
Text.title_en: 增量文本内容（Object=content 事件携带）
Text.title_zh: 增量文本内容（Object=content 事件携带）

TraceId.title_en: 全局 TraceId，仅在 Object=response 且 Status=completed 的结束事件中携带，用于后续额度/账单/问题排查的链路溯源
TraceId.title_zh: 全局 TraceId，仅在 Object=response 且 Status=completed 的结束事件中携带，用于后续额度/账单/问题排查的链路溯源

Type.description_en: The message type (reasoning (model thinking process) / message (formal reply))
Type.description_zh: 消息类型（reasoning（模型思考过程） / message（正式回复））
Type.title_en: 消息类型（reasoning（模型思考过程） / message（正式回复））
Type.title_zh: 消息类型（reasoning（模型思考过程） / message（正式回复））
